'''Kylaena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was present on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]]<ref name="SonyCite-Create your own Dazzling Fireworks!">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80114|text=Create your own Dazzling Fireworks!}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kylaena was the nickname of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' designer [[Janessa Johansson]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swggpdiscussion&message.id=994272|text=Meet the SWG Devs and Team: Come Say Hi!}}</ref>
